verses.en: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
verses.sm: Tavita. I Oute vivii atu ia te oe le ALII ma loʻu loto atoa; ou te ta‘uta‘u atu foi ou vavega uma.

verses.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
verses.sm: Out fiafia ma ou olioli ia te oe; ou te pese lava i lou suafa, le Silisili ese.

verses.en: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
verses.sm: 11 12 13 4 15 16 17 SALAMO Na liutuaina o e ua ita mai ia te au; ona tausuai ai lea o i latou,

verses.en: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
verses.sm: ma fano lava ai ou luma. Aua ua є faia loʻu faamasinoga ma laʻu finauga;

verses.en: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
verses.sm: ua e tietie i le nofoālii e faamasino tonu ai. Ua e aozi atu i nuu ese; ua faaumatia e oe o e amio leaga, ua e sõloiesea o latou igoa e oo i le faavavau faavavau lava.

verses.en: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
verses.sm: O e ita rnai, ua faaumatia e faavavau o latou faatafunaga; ua e olopalaina aai; ua galo lava le faamanatuina o i latou.

verses.en: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
verses.sm: A ole ALII, e tietie lava ia e faavavau; ua saunia e ia lona nofoālii e faamasino ai.

verses.en: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
verses.sm: O ia lava na te faamasinoina le atu laulau ma le tonu; na te faatonuina ma le saʻo finauga a nuu.

verses.en: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
verses.sm: O le ALII e fai ma ‘olo maualuga mo le ua faasauaina, o le ‘olo maualuga i ona po e i ai le puapuaga.

verses.en: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
verses.sm: E faatuatua ia te oe o e ua iloa lou suafa; aua, ALII e, e te le tuuna i latou o e saili ia te oe.

verses.en: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
verses.sm: Ina pepese atu ia outou i le ALII, o loo afio i Siona; ina faaali atu ia i nuu ana mea na fai.

verses.en: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
verses.sm: Auā o lë taui i le toto na te manatua i latou; na te le faagalogaloina le tagi o e ua puapuagatia.

verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
verses.sm: Le ALII e, ia e alofa mai ia te au, ia e s'lasila mai i loʻu puapuaga na tupu mai i e ua ‘ʻinoʻino mai ia te au, o oe na ole ua aveina ae aʻu ai faitotoa o le oti;

verses.en: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.sm: ina ia ou ta'uta'u atu ou Viiga uma i faitotoa o le tama fafine a Siona; ou te fiafia i lau faaolataga.

verses.en: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
verses.sm: Ua gogoto nuu ese i le lua na latou faia; o lea lava upega na natia e i latou ua lavea ai o latou vae.

verses.en: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
verses.sm: E iloa le ALII i le faamasinoga ua na faia; ua maileia le fai amio leaga i le galuega a ona lava lima. !Ikaiona. Sela.

verses.en: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.
verses.sm: E tulia i seoli o e fai amio leaga, o nuu uma lava o e faagalogalo i le Atua.

verses.en: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
verses.sm: Auā e le faagalogaloina e faavavau o e matitiva; o le faamoemoega foi o e ua puapuagatia e le fano lea a le tu a le tu lava.

verses.en: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
verses.sm: Le Aw: e, ina tulai mai ia, aua neʻi manumalo tagata; ia faamasinoina nuu ese i ou juma.

verses.en: Put them in fear, O LORD: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
verses.sm: Le Atu e, ia e faamatatau ia te i latou; ia iloa e nuu ese o tagata lava i latou. Sela.
